required_checks: exact base request equals current deterministic family template
exact fingerprint of all base fields and current scenario identity
proposed_rule.allowed_use: Ask a local steward whether these data classes and definitions exist, then request only minimum-necessary locally approved aggregate summaries and episode counts after small-cell, overlap and differencing review. No person-level records, intervention recommendation, interoperability certification or resource-to-metric guarantee.
proposed_rule.unknown_payer_setting: Not predicates granting clinical applicability. No local system/payer/vendor is asserted available; mandatory local confirmation precedes any acquisition outside this app.
proposed_rule.other_contexts: Withhold until separately reviewed exact policy version; local_context_id changes, other pathway/mechanism, unknown family, invalid scenario or changed artifact fail closed.

currentness: Base request matching unchanged. Optional hint identity has separate currentness; registry/policy/review/request changes withhold guidance until explicit valid reattachment. No automatic Brief selection.
release_chain: Mapping and context policy do not hash a future review. Independent review pins these plus sources; admitted registry then pins review/policy/source digests; external allowlist pins registry and those identities. Changes require new review/release identity.
gate_requirement: Gate1 admission or explicit independent governance disposition before advancing Gate2/consumer implementation.
